% PGF manual decorations.text: reverse the decorated path, not the text order.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.text}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm]
  \draw[help lines,gray!35,step=1cm] (0,0) grid (6,3);
  \draw[gray,->]
    [postaction={decorate,decoration={text along path,text={a big juicy apple},
      text color=red,raise=2pt},decorate}]
    [postaction={decorate,decoration={text along path,text={a big juicy apple},
      text color=blue,raise=2pt,reverse path},decorate}]
    (5.5,0.4) .. controls (5.5,2.5) and (0.5,2.5) .. (0.5,0.4);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
